title: Goodles mac and cheese with meatballs, buttered corn
ingredients: 4 boxes Goodles mac and cheese, plus the milk and butter the box calls for
BBQ sauce, a light drizzle (it's sugary)

steps.do: Heat the oven and put the meatballs in, per the bag (about 20 minutes).
Meanwhile cook the Goodles per the box.
need: milk and butter, per the box

steps.do: Steam the corn in the microwave, with salt, pepper and a little butter.
Toss the meatballs with a little BBQ sauce and serve with the mac and corn.

changes: Corn from your freezer instead of green beans.
